people.name: Joppa
people.line: An ancient seaport, the main port for Jerusalem

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa, and get Simon, who is called Peter,
translations.bsb: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
translations.kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
translations.asv: and he told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying, Send to Joppa, and fetch Simon, whose surname is Peter;
